name: fundzwatch-mcp
description: Real-time business event intelligence for AI agents — AI-scored leads, funding events, market pulse, and watchlists from FundzWatch.ai
long_description: FundzWatch gives AI agents real-time access to verified business events: funding rounds, executive moves, acquisitions, and AI-scored leads matched to your ideal customer profile. Manage watchlists and pull daily market briefs. Get a free API key (no credit card) at https://fundzwatch.ai/onboarding.

api_key.title: FundzWatch API Key
api_key.description: Your FundzWatch API key. Get a free key (no credit card) at https://fundzwatch.ai/onboarding
